many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
def solve(inp):
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # find rectangles (contiguous blocks)
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    rects=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                c=inp[i][j]; cells=[]
                st=(i,j); seen[i][j]=True
                while True:
                    r,c2=st
                    if r+1<H and not seen[r+1][c2] and inp[r+1][c2]==c:
                        seen[r+1][c2]=True; st=(r+1,c2)
                    else: break
                for x,y in cells: pass
                # BFS
                q=[(i,j)]; cells=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True
                rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
                top,bot=min(rs),max(rs); left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
                rects.append((top,bot,left,right,c))
    # demo: 4x4 -> corner1 edge4 center2 : map from cell pos relative to rect
    def fill(top,bot,left,right,c,out):
        for r in range(top,bot+1):
            for col in range(left,right+1):
                v=inp[r][col]
                if v!=c or out is None: continue
                dr=r-top; dc=col-left
                if dr==0 and dc==0: out[r][col]=1
                elif dr==0 and dc==right-left: out[r][col]=1
                elif dr==bot-top and dc==0: out[r][col]=1
                elif dr==bot-top and dc==right-left: out[r][col]=1
                elif dr==0 or dc==0 or dr==bot-top or dc==right-left: out[r][col]=4
                else: out[r][col]=2
    for t_,b,l,r_,c in rects:
        out=None
        fill(t_,b,l,r_,c,out)
    return out
